product_one_liner.value: PolyAI helps enterprises build, deploy, govern and improve conversational AI agents that handle complex customer-service interactions.
product_one_liner.notes: The official description identifies enterprises as the audience and explains that PolyAI builds, runs, governs and improves dialog agents for complex customer conversations. Source: https://poly.ai/about

pricing_page.notes: PolyAI has a public pricing page presenting pricing plans. Source: https://www.polyai.com/pricing

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The official customers page links customer case studies for PG&E and Carter's, describing operational results achieved with PolyAI. Source: https://poly.ai/customers | named_customers.0: The customer case-study title identifies Pacific Gas and Electric and its results with PolyAI. | named_customers.1: The customer case-study title identifies Carter's and its results with PolyAI.

employee_band.notes: PolyAI's company profile explicitly lists company size as 201–500 employees. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/18328585

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company's current LinkedIn page explicitly lists San Francisco as headquarters. An undated property-owner announcement instead describes London as its new headquarters, so the current company-controlled designation is used with reduced confidence. Sources: https://linkedin.com/company/18328585 and https://paddingtoncentral.com/latest/news/polyai-3-sheldon-square | hq_country: The company's current LinkedIn page explicitly designates San Francisco as headquarters and places that location in the US. This is preferred over the undated London-headquarters relocation article; the conflicting London evidence prevents high confidence. Sources: https://linkedin.com/company/18328585 and https://paddingtoncentral.com/latest/news/polyai-3-sheldon-square

founded_year.notes: The official company page explicitly states that PolyAI was founded in 2017. Source: https://poly.ai/about

eng_blog.notes: Two technical posts explain how PolyAI builds its models: the Owl article describes ASR fine-tuning and is authored by machine-learning engineer Tomasz Cichy; the Dialog-RSN-1 article, authored by VP Research Matt Henderson, explains supervised and reinforcement fine-tuning. Sources: https://poly.ai/blog/owl-speech-recognition-model-polyai and https://poly.ai/blog/polyai-dialog-rsn-1

public_docs.notes: The public API reference links multiple documentation sections, including conversations, runtime data and programmatic chat messaging. Source: https://docs.poly.ai/api-reference/introduction

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A live application page lists Forward Deployed AI Engineer – Vancouver, a qualifying AI engineering title. Source: https://job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io/polyai/jobs/4880510101

model_provider.value: PolyAI's proprietary models, including Raven, Dialog-RSN-1 and Owl.
model_provider.notes: PolyAI identifies Raven as its proprietary dialog model, describes building Dialog-RSN-1, and introduces Owl as its speech-recognition model. Models merely evaluated during research are excluded. Sources: https://job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io/polyai/jobs/4932846101, https://poly.ai/blog/polyai-dialog-rsn-1 and https://poly.ai/blog/owl-speech-recognition-model-polyai

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: PolyAI explicitly claims SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certification and GDPR compliance. GDPR is included as a publicly claimed compliance status, not as an independently issued certification. Source: https://poly.ai/our-partners/aws | compliance_certs.0: The official page explicitly claims SOC2 certification. | compliance_certs.1: The official page explicitly claims ISO27001 certification. | compliance_certs.2: The official page explicitly states GDPR compliance.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest identified funding announcement explicitly labels the round Series D. Source: https://poly.ai/blog/polyai-raises-86m-to-transform-how-enterprises-talk-to-their-customers | funding_date: The announcement of the latest identified round is dated December 15, 2025, giving 2025-12 in the requested format. Source: https://poly.ai/blog/polyai-raises-86m-to-transform-how-enterprises-talk-to-their-customers | funding_amount_usd: The latest identified funding announcement states that PolyAI raised $86 million in Series D funding. Source: https://poly.ai/blog/polyai-raises-86m-to-transform-how-enterprises-talk-to-their-customers

raised_18mo.notes: The $86 million Series D announced December 15, 2025 falls within the preceding 18 months. Source: https://poly.ai/blog/polyai-raises-86m-to-transform-how-enterprises-talk-to-their-customers

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live job application page lists an Account Executive, Mid Market opening. Source: https://job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io/polyai/jobs/4932846101

launched_6mo.notes: PolyAI introduced its Dialog-RSN-1 model in July 2026 and announced its availability on AWS SageMaker on October 6, 2026; both fall within the six-month window. Sources: https://poly.ai/blog/polyai-dialog-rsn-1 and https://poly.ai/blog/dialog-rsn-1-aws-sagemaker

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The May 12, 2026 company announcement names Morgan Norman as the newly appointed Chief Marketing Officer, within the 12-month window. Source: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/polyai-accelerates-global-momentum-with-senior-leadership-hires-and-expansion-to-canada-302769185.html

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: PolyAI's GTM Systems job posting identifies Salesforce as the center of its systems and explicitly names Outreach, Gong, HubSpot and Clay as surrounding tools.
